title: Kaii-bu: M-ken Y-shi no Kaigenshou ni Tsuite
titleRomaji: Kaii-bu: M-ken Y-shi no Kaigenshou ni Tsuite
titleNative: 怪異部～M県Y市の怪現象について～
synopsis: When transfer student Sakura Sakuraba arrives in Yuuyamichou, she discovers a place steeped in bizarre, ancient customs. The children there all have strange names and are bound by a curse that prevents them from leaving the city until they graduate high school. Caught in an escalating nightmare, Sakura must navigate curses, summonings, and betrayals. To break the curse and free the children, Sakura teams up with Uzu Andou, the mysterious president of the Paranormal Club. Their strange "club activities" are about to begin! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Nekonome Yuuka wa Katarubekarazu
titleNative: 猫ノ目ゆうかは語るべからず
synopsis: “This academy has multiple ‘taboos’—” Seirin Girls' Academy — a prestigious institution steeped in history, renowned as one of the prefecture's foremost finishing schools for young ladies. Mio Tsujihara, who has just transferred here, finds herself strongly drawn to a figure deemed taboo: Yuka Nekomine. Meeting Yuka will draw Mio into more inexplicable events. Because… "Yuka Nekomine is dead." Who was she, really? And what is the secret hidden within this academy where so many brilliant, delicate girls live? The most terrifying school mystery, filled with unsettling unease and psychological terror! (Source; Young Champion Web, translated)
